features.rationale: Turn the cylindrical shaft, with the left end at z=0 and the right end at z=8.000.
Chamfer the two outside circular end edges only.
Cut the centered transverse through-opening; the following corner fillets complete its rounded rectangular profile.
features.justification: The top view centers the opening transversely; section A-A shows it breaking through the shaft. Start and finish beyond the OD envelope to avoid coincident cut limits.

features.rationale: Round the four internal longitudinal-to-cut corner edges to produce the specified through-opening corner radii.
Cut the upper entrance recess to its specified floor, retaining its independently dimensioned axial position. Outer corner rounding is separately unresolved.
features.justification: Section A-A places the recess floor .500 below the upper OD crown. Cutting upward from that floor beyond the OD gives the exact recess depth. Transverse centering is explicitly called out; axial centering on the inner opening is not imposed.

features.rationale: What radius applies to the four outer recess corners: does the .250 R TYP. callout on the inner opening also govern them?
features.justification: The outer recess corners are visibly rounded, but the leader terminates on the inner opening. D005 is a candidate only; do not execute this fillet until its applicability is confirmed. F005 is an intermediate sharp-corner recess, not a claim that the finished recess has square corners.

features.rationale: Model the left coaxial internal thread cosmetically on its standard tap-drill bore.
features.justification: Use the conventional Unified 1-1/2-12 tap-drill chart size 1-27/64 inch (1.421875). The modeled flat-bottom bore extends to the specified tapped depth; uncalled-for drill-point geometry and additional manufacturing drilling allowance are not added.

spec.thread: 1.500-12 TAP; depth D012; class not specified

features.rationale: Drill the right coaxial screw passage into the transverse opening and counterbore it from the right end.
features.justification: For the D018 = .500 SHCS, the supplied ASME B18.3 normal-fit SHCS chart gives .531 clearance drill and .812 counterbore diameter. The printed D017 depth overrides the chart's default head-seat depth. Section A-A shows the clearance passage terminating in the transverse opening, not continuing into the left web; D005 provides overshoot into that opening.

features.rationale: Create the lower-left right-end tapped hole as the seed of the four-hole pattern.
features.justification: The standard tap drill for 3/8-16 UNC is 5/16 inch (.3125). Model the specified tapped extent as a flat-bottom cosmetic-thread bore without adding unspecified drilling allowances. End-view coordinates are relative to the shaft axis, not its bounding-box corner.

spec.thread: .375-16 TAP; depth D016; class not specified

features.rationale: Complete the symmetric two-column, two-row pattern of right-end tapped holes.
features.justification: The right end view shows mirror-image hole locations about both centerlines, giving coordinates (±D019, ±D020).

notes: The outer recess corner radius remains unresolved; the plan is not a fully released exact finished model until F006 is resolved.
D021 controls perpendicularity of the opening's right axial wall to datum A; D022 controls perpendicularity of the right end face. Retain both .001 requirements as inspection metadata.
Retain the printed tolerances and surface-texture callouts, including OD texture 16 and indicated machined surfaces 125; these do not alter nominal solid geometry.
Heat treatment: DIRECT HDN. R/C 28-32; IONITRIDE OUTSIDE DIA. ONLY, .008 MIN. CASE DEPTH, R/C 49 MIN. D023 describes treatment depth, not a geometric cut.

Tapped-hole depths are the specified thread extents. Cosmetic threads and flat-bottom bore representations do not specify additional pilot drilling depth, drill points, or unprinted thread fit classes.
Do not substitute nominal screw or thread diameters for clearance or tap-drill diameters. The central screw passage opens only into the transverse slot.
